entries.title: II Corinthians 5:1
segments: ¶For we know that if our earthly house, [this] tent, is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:2
segments: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:3
segments: if indeed, having been clothed, we shall not be found naked.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:4
segments: For we who are in [this] tent groan, being burdened, not because we want to be unclothed, but further clothed, that mortality may be swallowed up by life.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:5
segments: Now He who has prepared us for this very thing [is] God, who also has given us the Spirit as a guarantee.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:6
segments: So [we are] always confident, knowing that while we are at home in the body we are absent from the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:7
segments: For we walk by faith, not by sight.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:8
segments: We are confident, yes, well pleased rather to be absent from the body and to be present with the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:9
segments: Therefore we make it our aim, whether present or absent, to be well pleasing to Him.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:10
segments: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive the things [done] in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:11
segments: Knowing, therefore, the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are well known to God, and I also trust are well known in your consciences.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:12
segments: ¶For we do not commend ourselves again to you, but give you opportunity to boast on our behalf, that you may have [an answer] for those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:13
segments: For if we are beside ourselves, [it is] for God; or if we are of sound mind, [it is] for you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:14
segments: For the love of Christ compels us, because we judge thus: that if One died for all, then all died;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:15
segments: and He died for all, that those who live should live no longer for themselves, but for Him who died for them and rose again.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:16
segments: ¶Therefore, from now on, we regard no one according to the flesh. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know [Him thus] no longer.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:17
segments: Therefore, if anyone [is] in Christ, [he is] a new creation; old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:18
segments: Now all things [are] of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given us the ministry of reconciliation,

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:19
segments: that is, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and has committed to us the word of reconciliation.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:20
segments: Now then, we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were pleading through us: we implore [you] on Christ's behalf, be reconciled to God.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:21
segments: For He made Him who knew no sin [to be] sin for us, that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.
